description: This file contains functions for resolving various conversation-related identifiers (channel, account ID, thread ID, conversation ID, parent conversation ID) based on message context and commands in an OpenCLAW project. It leverages external functions to resolve these identifiers and provides utility functions for binding context extraction.

methods.name: export function resolveAcpCommandChannel(params: HandleCommandsParams): string { resolveAcpCommandChannel
methods.description: Resolves the communication channel associated with a given command, normalizing and converting it to lowercase.

methods.name: export function resolveAcpCommandAccountId(params: HandleCommandsParams): string { resolveAcpCommandAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the account ID associated with the message context and command channel.

methods.name: export function resolveAcpCommandThreadId(params: HandleCommandsParams): string | undefined { resolveAcpCommandThreadId
methods.description: Gets the thread ID from the message context, if available.

methods.name: function resolveAcpCommandConversationRef(params: HandleCommandsParams): { resolveAcpCommandConversationRef
methods.description: Internal function that resolves the conversation reference (ID and optional parent ID) based on the message context.

methods.name: export function resolveAcpCommandConversationId(params: HandleCommandsParams): string | undefine/ resolveAcpCommandConversationId
methods.description: Extracts the conversation ID from the resolved conversation reference.

methods.name: export function resolveAcpCommandParentConversationId( resolveAcpCommandParentConversationId
methods.description: Extracts the parent conversation ID, if present, from the conversation reference.

methods.name: export function resolveAcpCommandBindingContext(params: HandleCommandsParams): { resolveAcpCommandBindingContext
methods.description: Builds a comprehensive binding context object containing channel, account ID, thread ID, conversation ID, and parent conversation ID as applicable.
